scaled_pdb_tokenization_cameo.description: Protein backbone structure tokenization on the scaled CAMEO held-out split. Reference values use two reported structural-tokenizer operating points from the paper's Table 16.
scaled_pdb_tokenization_cameo.notes: RMSD, lDDT, BPR, and vocabulary size are copied from the paper's Table 16 rows. The compact gym uses lDDT as the primary reconstruction-quality metric because the small public subset reproduces local-distance preservation more faithfully than global RMSD. RMSD remains scored as a secondary distortion metric. The benchmark computes BPR as a reproducible encoded-token proxy, so reproduced BPR is not expected to match the paper's full description-length BPR exactly.

rmsd.description: Global geometric reconstruction error between original and reconstructed backbone coordinates.

lddt.description: Primary local distance preservation score that rewards reconstructed backbones with native-like local geometry.

bpr.description: Encoded-token bits-per-residue proxy that penalizes inefficient structural encodings.

vocab_size.description: Vocabulary compactness constraint that discourages memorizing structures with an unbounded token set.

short_backbones.description: Compact lossy coding of complete 64–192 residue protein backbones on 64 unseen chains.
short_backbones.notes: Scaled RCSB corpus, distinct from the paper evaluation splits. Results here are measured reference values, not paper targets. Full finite dictionary storage is charged. Paper Table 16 values are retained verbatim under _paper_reported.

rmsd.description: Mean complete-backbone RMSD in angstroms after proper Kabsch alignment.

lddt.description: Mean per-residue CA lDDT, 15 angstrom inclusion radius and tolerances 0.5, 1, 2, 4 angstroms.

bpr.description: Encoded streams plus the shared dictionary charged once across the full corpus, in bits per native residue.

vocab_size.description: Total dictionary and boundary alphabet size, also limited to 8192.
